n, m, md = map(int, input().split())

# Initialize the combination table c
c = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
for i in range(n + 1):
    c[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j] + c[i - 1][j - 1]) % md

# Initialize arrays
f = [0] * (n + 1)
rst = [0] * (n + 1)
for i in range(n):
    for k in range(i + 1):
        cur = c[i][k]
        crst = 0
        if k > 0:
            crst = (crst * f[k - 1] + cur * rst[k - 1]) % md
            cur = (cur * f[k - 1]) % md
        if k < i:
            crst = (crst * f[i - k - 1] + cur * rst[i - k - 1]) % md
            cur = (cur * f[i - k - 1]) % md
        rst[i] = (rst[i] + crst * (i + 2) + cur * ( (k * (k + 1) // 2) + ((i - k) * (i - k + 1) // 2) )) % md
        f[i] = (f[i] + (i + 2) * cur) % md

# Initialize DP tables
dpf = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
dpr = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
dpf[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(i, m) + 1):
        dpf[i][j] = dpf[i - 1][j]
        dpr[i][j] = dpr[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            prv = i - k
            if prv > 0:
                prv -= 1
            if j - k <= prv:
                val1 = (dpr[prv][j - k] * f[k - 1]) % md
                val2 = (dpf[prv][j - k] * rst[k - 1]) % md
                dpr[i][j] = (dpr[i][j] + c[j][k] * (val1 + val2)) % md
                dpf[i][j] = (dpf[i][j] + c[j][k] * dpf[prv][j - k] * f[k - 1]) % md

print(dpr[n][m])
